subject: Reminder about the frame quote and a happy update
text:
Hi there,

Just a friendly nudge about the quote for the exhibition frames. I know your studio has been swamped, but as the freelancer on this job, I'm hoping you can confirm whether the pricing still holds, so I can get the deposit sorted this week. The piece I submitted to the regional showcase actually made the final selection, so I'm suddenly juggling a bit more mounting work than I first imagined. It's a happy problem, and it means the frames will likely go into use sooner than I had pencilled in.

If there's any change to the lead time, please let me know early enough that I can adjust the studio schedule. I've also tucked the revised dimensions into the shared folder under the date from last Tuesday. There was a tiny correction around the bottom border, but nothing that should force a remake unless the glass stock has changed since our last chat.

Also, if you'd rather have the payment via the old card than bank transfer, just say the word. I can switch it over once the revised quote is back, and I'll leave enough room for any rush fees you think are sensible.

Really appreciate you picking up the phone when the courier tried the wrong delivery bay. It saved a whole afternoon. I'll keep my email alert in case a quick approval from you pops through overnight.

Many thanks
